title: Perfect Square Board
statement: A board game asks whether n tiles can form a full square board. Return true if n is a perfect square (s × s = n for a whole s), without a square-root function.

answerKey.pattern: Binary search on the side length
keyPoints: Compare s × s with n using 64-bit products

hints: Which number are you searching for, and between which bounds?
The side s: s × s grows with s, so binary search it.
Use 64-bit multiplication so s × s does not overflow.
